page_note: This page is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate teaching: the five planets (Zeus/Aphrodite/Ares/Hermes/Kronos) systematically mapped to the five Worlds (Smoke/Fire/Wind/Water/Darkness), the two Anabibazons mapped to Fire and Pleasure (the Dry-One and Abomination, Father and Mother), Sun and Moon as bound rulers, and the twelve zodiac signs distributed in groups of three across four sides of the surrounding sphere. Pure planet→world and zodiac→quadrant correspondence — both sides of every mapping internal to the cosmic system. Only segment 16 contains a frame formula ('Once again I reveal forth to you') wrapping a substantive cosmological topic ('concerning the zodiac-signs'), classified as mixed. The seam flag at 16 is a topic-shift marker introducing the next teaching block, not an editorial intrusion. Heavy lacunation (~40%) but no editorial drift.
